Name: Custom Catalogues and Dressers
Author: pheauxm
Description:
For players:
This is a framework, meaning it won't do anything on its own but may be required for another mod to fully work properly.

For mod makers:
The documentation is [url=https://github.com/pheaux-prometheus/customcatalogues/blob/main/README.md]on Github[/url], but here's a quick description of what you can do with this mod:

• designate objects like furniture and big craftables as catalogues that open your own shop
• create dressers that accept items other than just clothing and wearables
• give your custom catalogues and dressers their own unique tabs with custom textures and filters

All of this can be done through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for ease.

Manifest.Name: Custom Catalogues and Dressers
Manifest.Description: Allows the creation of custom catalogues and dressers for mod authors.
